limits: The pilot intentionally stopped before cosine or nearest-neighbor ranking because that would create a project-owned retrieval layer.
The frozen archive may differ from later Needle 3 releases that add a contrastive embedding head.
The exact source and model/engine artifacts were pinned, but the transitive Python dependency environment was observed rather than frozen.
The three-call embedding timing is a tiny same-process capability probe, not a repository-scale retrieval benchmark.
Successful offline execution with exact local files proves this path did not require working network access; it does not establish that every Needle command is network-free.
